subject: OptivaTech SSO + SCIM + Network guardrails — implementation kickoff
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena.park@optivatech.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood onboarding — SSO / SCIM / IP allowlists

Hi Soojin,

We’re ready to start the enterprise onboarding for OptivaTech. High level: we need SSO (SAML) with Okta, SCIM sync for user + group attributes, production IP allowlist for egress to your API endpoints, and two service accounts for automated provisioning and logs ingestion. We also have a couple of org-level policies we’ll want enforced (max session length, MFA required for admin roles).

Can you share a mutual action plan and proposed timeline? I’ve attached a short matrix of our requirements (enterprise-sso-reqs.pdf).

Also: security@optivatech.com should be looped in for technical items. We’d prefer a kickoff this week if possible.

Thanks,
Lena
Lena Park
Head of IT Operations, OptivaTech
+1 415-555-0187

Attachment: enterprise-sso-reqs.pdf (pdf)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — SSO / SCIM / IP allowlists

Hi Lena — thanks for the note and the attachment. Welcome aboard.

Quick response with a proposed mutual action plan attached (mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx). High-level milestones we recommend:
- Technical kickoff (identify IdP contact + SAML metadata) — target within 48 hours
- SCIM attribute mapping and PATCH validation (test tenant) — 3 business days
- IP allowlist validation & staging cutover — 2 business days following SCIM tests
- Service account provisioning + least-privilege review — same sprint as cutover
- Production cutover + smoke tests — scheduled once staging passes

Questions we have now:
1) Can you share your Okta metadata URL or metadata XML?
2) Do you require SCIM PATCH or only PUT?
3) Please confirm public IP ranges that need to be whitelisted for your outbound firewall.

Marissa will lead the SCIM mapping and Karthik will handle org policy and service-account scoping. I’ll coordinate the schedule and the kickoff invite.

Proposed kickoff slots: Wed 10/6 15:00 ET or Thu 10/7 11:00 ET — let us know which works.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachment: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lena Park <lena.park@optivatech.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — SSO / SCIM / IP allowlists

Looping in a couple of implementation notes from the SCIM side:
- Our SCIM service supports PATCH and bulk PUT; PATCH is preferred for incremental syncs (less friction for large orgs).
- We need the following attributes mapped: userName, externalId, name.givenName, name.familyName, emails[type=work], groups[displayName].
- For groups-based entitlements: confirm whether you want group creation delegated to Redwood or managed from Okta. If you want us to manage group lifecycle we’ll need a service account with group.write scope.
- For service accounts: recommend two accounts — scim-sync@optivatech (read/write users+groups) and logs-ingest@optivatech (write-only to the ingest endpoint). We’ll provide exact scopes.

I’ll prepare a short runbook for the staging tests. Karthik, can you add the org policy checklist (session lengths, admin MFA, device attestation) to the mutual_action_plan?

—Marissa
Senior Implementation Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Lena Park <lena.park@optivatech.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Oct 2027 08:15:00 -0700

Thanks, team — answers below and attached metadata.
- Okta metadata: attached okta-metadata.xml (we support SAML 2.0 and provide the metadata blob).
- SCIM: we support PATCH (recommended).
- IP ranges to whitelist (egress to Redwood endpoints): 54.187.12.0/24, 3.10.45.0/24 (attached network-egress.pdf with full list).
- Service accounts: we can create scim-sync@optivatech and logs-ingest@optivatech in Okta; they’ll be API-only accounts (no console access).

We’d prefer the kickoff on Wed 10/6 15:00 ET — I’ll accept the invite once you send it.

Lena

See you on Wednesday.
